question: What is the total zero-rated (export) outward supply value across all GSTR-3B returns?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(oz.txval) AS v FROM public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b r JOIN public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b_sup_details s ON s.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b = r.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b JOIN public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b_sup_details_osupzero oz ON oz.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b_sup_details = s.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b_sup_details;

question: What is the total nil-rated and exempt outward supply value across all GSTR-3B returns?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(onx.txval) AS v FROM public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b r JOIN public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b_sup_details s ON s.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b = r.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b JOIN public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b_sup_details_osupnilexmp onx ON onx.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b_sup_details = s.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b_sup_details;

question: What is the total non-GST outward supply value in financial year 2024-25?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(ong.txval) AS v FROM public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b r JOIN public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b_sup_details s ON s.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b = r.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b JOIN public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b_sup_details_osupnongst ong ON ong.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b_sup_details = s.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b_sup_details JOIN common.mst_3bd_months_t m ON m.ret_period_fl = r.ret_period WHERE m.fy_flag = 8;

question: What is the total ITC available on all inward supplies (SGST + CGST + IGST) across all GSTR-3B returns?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(av.samt + av.camt + av.iamt) AS v FROM public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b r JOIN public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b_itc_elg e ON e.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b = r.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b JOIN public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b_itc_elg_itc_avl av ON av.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b_itc_elg = e.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b_itc_elg;

question: What is the total IGST paid through ITC for each division?
gold_sql: SELECT j.division, SUM(pi.i_pdi + pi.i_pdc + pi.i_pds) AS v FROM public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b r JOIN common.t_all_delers_api_v_t d ON d.gstin = r.gstin JOIN common.mst_state_jurisdiction_code j ON j.state_jur_code = d.stjd JOIN public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b_tx_pmt p ON p.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b = r.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b JOIN public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b_tx_pmt_pd_itc pi ON pi.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b_tx_pmt = p.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b_tx_pmt GROUP BY j.division;

question: List the top 3 taxpayers by total tax paid in cash across all years.
gold_sql: SELECT r.gstin FROM public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b r JOIN public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b_tx_pmt p ON p.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b = r.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b JOIN public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b_tx_pmt_pd_cash pc ON pc.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b_tx_pmt = p.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b_tx_pmt GROUP BY r.gstin ORDER BY SUM(pc.ipd + pc.cpd + pc.spd + pc.cspd) DESC LIMIT 3;

question: What is the total zero-rated supply value per financial year, labelled by year?
gold_sql: SELECT y.desc_year, SUM(oz.txval) AS v FROM public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b r JOIN public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b_sup_details s ON s.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b = r.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b JOIN public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b_sup_details_osupzero oz ON oz.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b_sup_details = s.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b_sup_details JOIN common.mst_3bd_months_t m ON m.ret_period_fl = r.ret_period JOIN common.mst_fy_years_t y ON y.flag_fy = m.fy_flag GROUP BY y.desc_year;

question: How many GSTR-3B returns had net SGST ITC available above 50000?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b r JOIN public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b_itc_elg e ON e.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b = r.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b JOIN public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b_itc_elg_itc_net n ON n.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b_itc_elg = e.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b_itc_elg WHERE n.samt > 50000;

question: What is the average net IGST ITC available per return in financial year 2025-26?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(n.iamt) AS v FROM public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b r JOIN public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b_itc_elg e ON e.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b = r.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b JOIN public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b_itc_elg_itc_net n ON n.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b_itc_elg = e.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b_itc_elg JOIN common.mst_3bd_months_t m ON m.ret_period_fl = r.ret_period WHERE m.fy_flag = 9;

question: How many taxpayers had a total outward taxable value above 5000000 across all years?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM (SELECT r.gstin, SUM(o.txval) AS tot FROM public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b r JOIN public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b_sup_details s ON s.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b = r.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b JOIN public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b_sup_details_osupdet o ON o.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b_sup_details = s.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b_sup_details GROUP BY r.gstin) q WHERE q.tot > 5000000;

question: What is the total cess payable on outward supplies for each division?
gold_sql: SELECT j.division, SUM(o.csamt) AS v FROM public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b r JOIN common.t_all_delers_api_v_t d ON d.gstin = r.gstin JOIN common.mst_state_jurisdiction_code j ON j.state_jur_code = d.stjd JOIN public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b_sup_details s ON s.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b = r.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b JOIN public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b_sup_details_osupdet o ON o.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b_sup_details = s.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b_sup_details GROUP BY j.division;

question: What is the total SGST paid in cash per quarter in financial year 2025-26?
gold_sql: SELECT MAX(m.quarter) AS quarter, SUM(pc.spd) AS v FROM public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b r JOIN public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b_tx_pmt p ON p.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b = r.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b JOIN public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b_tx_pmt_pd_cash pc ON pc.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b_tx_pmt = p.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b_tx_pmt JOIN common.mst_3bd_months_t m ON m.ret_period_fl = r.ret_period WHERE m.fy_flag = 9 GROUP BY m.quarter_all_mnths;

question: How many distinct constitutions of business appear among registered taxpayers?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.cobz) AS n FROM common.t_all_delers_api_v_t d;

question: How many taxpayers have an unknown (NA) risk profile?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM common.t_all_delers_api_v_t d WHERE d.risk_profile = 'NA';

question: What is the division and range for the taxpayer Sangh Textiles Ltd?
gold_sql: SELECT j.division, j."range" FROM common.t_all_delers_api_v_t d JOIN common.mst_state_jurisdiction_code j ON j.state_jur_code = d.stjd WHERE d.trdnm ILIKE '%Sangh Textiles%';

question: What is the PAN number of the taxpayer Gujarat Cement Ltd?
gold_sql: SELECT d.pan_num FROM common.t_all_delers_api_v_t d WHERE d.trdnm ILIKE '%Gujarat Cement%';

question: List the trade names of taxpayers registered under CENTER approving authority.
gold_sql: SELECT d.trdnm FROM common.t_all_delers_api_v_t d WHERE d.appr_auth = 'CENTER' ORDER BY d.trdnm;

question: How many active taxpayers are there in each jurisdiction division?
gold_sql: SELECT j.division, COUNT(*) AS n FROM common.t_all_delers_api_v_t d JOIN common.mst_state_jurisdiction_code j ON j.state_jur_code = d.stjd WHERE d.canc_dt IS NULL GROUP BY j.division;

question: What is the total net SGST ITC available claimed by taxpayers under CENTER approving authority?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(n.samt) AS v FROM public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b r JOIN common.t_all_delers_api_v_t d ON d.gstin = r.gstin JOIN public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b_itc_elg e ON e.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b = r.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b JOIN public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b_itc_elg_itc_net n ON n.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b_itc_elg = e.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b_itc_elg WHERE d.appr_auth = 'CENTER';

question: Which jurisdiction range is the taxpayer Baroda Foods Ltd in?
gold_sql: SELECT j."range" FROM common.t_all_delers_api_v_t d JOIN common.mst_state_jurisdiction_code j ON j.state_jur_code = d.stjd WHERE d.trdnm ILIKE '%Baroda Foods%';

question: How many GSTR-3B returns were filed by taxpayers with a medium risk profile?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b r JOIN common.t_all_delers_api_v_t d ON d.gstin = r.gstin WHERE d.risk_profile ILIKE 'MEDIUM%';

question: What are the trade names of taxpayers in Division 1 (ABD)?
gold_sql: SELECT d.trdnm FROM common.t_all_delers_api_v_t d JOIN common.mst_state_jurisdiction_code j ON j.state_jur_code = d.stjd WHERE j.division = 'Division 1 (ABD)' ORDER BY d.trdnm;

question: What is the total assessable value of currently active e-way bills?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(assval) AS v FROM public.tbl_ewb_parta_ewb WHERE status = 'ACT';

question: How many e-way bills have a declared travel distance above 100 km?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM public.tbl_ewb_parta_ewb WHERE CAST(travdist AS INTEGER) > 100;

question: What is the average IGST value on inter-state e-way bills?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(igstval) AS v FROM public.tbl_ewb_parta_ewb WHERE frstat <> tostat;

question: Which 3 consignee states received the highest total assessable value of goods?
gold_sql: SELECT tostat FROM public.tbl_ewb_parta_ewb GROUP BY tostat ORDER BY SUM(assval) DESC LIMIT 3;

question: How many e-way bill item lines have an IGST rate above 12 percent?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM public.tbl_ewb_parta_ewb_itemlist WHERE igstrt > 12;

question: How many distinct deductees appear across GSTR-7 TDS records?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.gstin_ded) AS n FROM public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7_tds t;

question: What is the total CGST TDS withheld across all GSTR-7 returns?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(t.camt) AS v FROM public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7_tds t;

question: What is the total TDS (IGST + CGST + SGST) withheld by each deductor?
gold_sql: SELECT g.gstin, SUM(t.iamt + t.camt + t.samt) AS v FROM public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7 g JOIN public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7_tds t ON t.tbl_gst_rtn_r7 = g.idtbl_gst_rtn_r7 GROUP BY g.gstin;

question: Which deductor withheld the most total TDS?
gold_sql: SELECT g.gstin FROM public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7 g JOIN public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7_tds t ON t.tbl_gst_rtn_r7 = g.idtbl_gst_rtn_r7 GROUP BY g.gstin ORDER BY SUM(t.iamt + t.camt + t.samt) DESC LIMIT 1;

question: How many distinct liability IDs appear across GSTR-7 tax-payable records?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT liab_id) AS n FROM public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7_tax_pay;

question: How many taxpayers filed a GSTR-3B return in May 2025 but not in June 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM (SELECT r.gstin FROM public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b r WHERE r.ret_period = '052025' EXCEPT SELECT r2.gstin FROM public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b r2 WHERE r2.ret_period = '062025') q;

question: What is the total outward taxable value reported in the month named August of financial year 2024-25?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(o.txval) AS v FROM public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b r JOIN common.mst_3bd_months_t m ON m.ret_period_fl = r.ret_period JOIN common.mst_fy_years_t y ON y.flag_fy = m.fy_flag JOIN public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b_sup_details sd ON sd.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b = r.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b JOIN public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b_sup_details_osupdet o ON o.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b_sup_details = sd.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b_sup_details WHERE m.month_desc = 'August' AND y.desc_year = '2024-25';

question: What is the total tax paid in cash (IGST + CGST + SGST) for GSTR-7 returns of the period November 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(c.igst_tx + c.cgst_tx + c.sgst_tx) AS v FROM public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7 r JOIN public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7_tax_paid tp ON tp.tbl_gst_rtn_r7 = r.idtbl_gst_rtn_r7 JOIN public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7_tax_paid_pd_by_cash c ON c.idtbl_gst_rtn_r7_tax_paid = tp.idtbl_gst_rtn_r7_tax_paid WHERE r.fp = '112025';

question: How many deductors have at least one GSTR-7 return with no tax-paid record?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.gstin) AS n FROM public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7 r WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7_tax_paid p WHERE p.tbl_gst_rtn_r7 = r.idtbl_gst_rtn_r7);

question: What is the GSTIN of the casual dealer?
gold_sql: SELECT d.gstin FROM common.t_all_delers_api_v_t d WHERE d.iscasdl = 'Y';

question: How many taxpayers have a registration end date recorded but no cancellation date?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM common.t_all_delers_api_v_t d WHERE d.rgtodt IS NOT NULL AND d.canc_dt IS NULL;

question: How many registered taxpayers have never filed any GSTR-3B return?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM common.t_all_delers_api_v_t d WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b r WHERE r.gstin = d.gstin);

question: What is the total CGST amount of ITC reversed across all GSTR-3B returns?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(v.camt) AS v FROM public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b_itc_elg_itc_rev v;

question: What is the total CGST interest paid in cash across all GSTR-3B returns?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(pc.c_intrpd) AS v FROM public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b_tx_pmt_pd_cash pc;

question: How many TDS amendments increased the base amount compared to the original?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7_tdsa a WHERE a.amt_ded > a.oamt_ded;
